_comment: Business details. Fields whose value is the string REQUIRED_FROM_OWNER are deliberately blank. build_store.py refuses to produce a publishable build while any remain, so the store can never go live claiming a detail nobody supplied.

shipping._comment: These describe what we will actually do. Every figure here must be backed by a supplier quote before the store goes live, or it is a promise we cannot keep.

analytics._comment: Left null on purpose. No tracking script is embedded until the owner supplies a real property ID, because a placeholder ID silently collects nothing and looks like it works.

checkout._comment: No payment provider is wired up. Under zero spend authorization no account exists. The cart is real and functional; the checkout button explains what is missing rather than failing silently.
